name: fuzzy_hash
description: SHA-256 of a file (computed here: identity) and its ssdeep and TLSH digests (computed by the installed programs: byte similarity only), or a comparison of two files by TLSH distance. A digest is accepted only when it has the shape of that engine's digest. Each engine runs under a time limit with its whole output kept in a log file; an engine that fails, times out or prints something unrecognised is a per-engine status and the answer is partial; a comparison that cannot be made names the input that prevented it. Records each program's argv and what its version command printed. Requires ssdeep and tlsh. A similarity score is a lead: it does not establish a family. Every answer, a refusal and a stop by signal included, carries `status` and a one-sentence `status_basis` that names the engine, its status or the call's budget that decided it. An output directory reached through a symbolic link (the directory itself, work/ or the agent's directory under it, or $OUT/tool-output in a job) is refused and nothing is written through it.

compare_to.description: Optional second file to hash and compare with the first

engine_timeout_seconds.description: Time limit for each engine invocation, from 1 to 600 (default 120); the whole call is held to 270 seconds, whatever this is, and an engine not reached by then is not_attempted
